text:
marie: Quick thread — starting a lightweight bakeoff on the benchmark narrative for launch. Goal: one clear price-vs-speed story that maps to 3 launch assets (hero post, webinar short, gated deep-dive). Need chart choices + suggested copy hooks and inbound routing triggers.
ajay: Love it. Hypothesis first — customers care most about predictable p95 for chat flows, and tokens-per-dollar for batch/embedding use cases. If true, our headline should be ‘predictable latency, scaled efficiency’.
liam: Agree on p95 + cost-per-1k-tokens. Also include median and a tail summary (p99 or p999) for reliability callers. Suggest a 2x2 matrix slide: workload type (chat vs batch) x metric (latency vs cost).
sophia: For visuals: small-multiples across model families, color-coded by deployment mode (hosted / dedicated / private). Top-left: single stat hero (e.g., “<10ms per-token median on prompt X”), center: scatter plot price-per-second vs median latency, bottom: stacked waterfall showing unit economics (batching + caching delta). I can mock in Figma. link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/latency-econ
noah: Copy hooks we can A/B test: 1) "Latency you can budget for, savings you can measure" 2) "Fast where it matters, cheap where it counts" 3) "From tail spikes to token savings — predictable inference at scale" Which one maps to PLG hero vs enterprise email? (1 for enterprise, 2 for PLG)
marie: Nice. Webinar framing idea: 20-min session — 5 min problem, 8 min demo of the three charts + routing examples, 7 min q&a + call to action (dedicated trial or private POC). Target mid-market platform teams and infra folks.
ajay: Inbound routing: CTA on hero post -> qualification form with two toggles: workload type (chat/batch) and priority (latency/cost). Map responses: latency-priority -> SDR (fast-track demo), cost-priority batch -> self-serve nurture + case study. Also capture model sizes and peak TPS.
liam: For the scatter plot, data axes: x=median latency (ms), y=cost per 1k tokens (USD). Plot points: model variants + deployment mode. Add iso-lines for equal cost-per-latency product (visual aid). Could compute cost with `cost = tokens * unit_price / throughput` — I can export CSV.
sophia: Visual microcopy: callouts on scatter points like "dedicated lowers variance" and on waterfall: "prefix cache saved 37% tokens". Keep color palette accessible.
noah: Social captions: short, snappy: "Speed you can trust — unit economics you can plan. See our new benchmark." Variants for webinar invites: "Join our webinar: pick a workload, see live routing & numbers."
marie: Action items: sophia mock Figma comps by EOD Thu, liam to export CSV + sample calc + p95/p99 by Wed, noah to draft top 3 captions and 2 email subject lines, ajay to sketch inbound routing logic and SDR playbook. Benchbot: attach latest run and perf summary?
benchbot: automated: latest-benchmark-run-1752468000.csv attached to thread (summary below): median(chat)=12ms, p95(chat)=48ms, cost/1k= $0.87 (hosted), dedicated reduces p95 by ~30% on average.
ajay: Good. One ask — can we include an explicit SLA-friendly stat like "99.9% requests < X ms" even if it's a soft claim (we'll qualify in footnote).
liam: We can compute that but add asterisks for workload and prompt length. Also propose a compact table for the appendix: sample prompt, seq length, median, p95, cost/1k.
sophia: I’ll add a slide overlay for the webinar with CTA buttons: "Start dedicated trial" and "Request POC" — make the first more prominent for PLG flow.
noah: I'll draft the webinar landing headline + 3 bullets. Headline draft: "Benchmarking inference: speed, cost, and what to optimize next." Bullets: 1) Real numbers across deployment modes 2) Practical knobs (batching, caching, routing) 3) How we map metrics to GTM outcomes.
marie: Love it. Final note: let's avoid absolute-sounding claims without data; use "observed" and include methodology appendix. Also plan a follow-up deep-dive blog post with the CSV + reproducibility steps.
ajay: Agree. TL;DR for comms: one hero stat (median or p95 depending on audience), scatter for price-vs-speed, waterfall for unit econ, CTA that maps to routed lead flows.
marie: Perfect. I'll compile into a one-pager and drop in Google Drive. Back here after mocks and CSV exports. :sparkles:
